cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Stay for the Hard Part
cards.instruction: Create increasing moments of emotional honesty to test whether someone remains present and supportive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I wasn't just late to the reunion. Can I tell you?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I saved you a seat beside me. Was it the traffic?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. No. I waited outside for half an hour. Can you hear why?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm here. But I thought you didn't want to sit with me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I wanted that seat. I was afraid you'd be happier without me there. Will you sit beside me now?

mechanism: A directs a hearing of a late-arrival account, grants progressively more vulnerable details and asks B to demonstrate continued presence after the hardest admission.
confusable: D88 gets B attachment first; D107 makes A own honesty the escalating test of support.
comparison: A feared reunion seat differs from an anniversary trip whose cancellation concealed relationship concern.
seedUse: Use D107-b outside wait and B mistaken unwanted-seat inference, which must cause the final honest fear of being unwanted.
